ketu_house.station: a life turned on its own resources: standing alone, doing things by one's own hand, and an independence that did not have to be taught
callings: any work done alone and by one's own hand

ketu_house.station: a life lived inside a household and its means: family, food, speech and the keeping of what was earned
callings: the keeping of a household's wealth
reciting, singing or the spoken word

ketu_house.station: a life of effort and nerve: initiative, journeys close to home, messages carried, and skill with the hands
callings: a craft worked with the hands
work that took courage more than rank

ketu_house.station: a settled life on the land: a house, fields or property, vehicles, and the care of a household
callings: the keeping of land or a house
work rooted to one place and one family

ketu_house.station: a life of learning and counsel: study, teaching, advice given, devotion and recitation
callings: the care and instruction of children

ketu_house.station: a life of service: healing and medicine, discipline, dealing with conflict, debts and the troubles of others
callings: work that dealt with other people's troubles

ketu_house.station: a life bound to others: marriage, partnership, trade and constant dealing with the public
callings: work that was always done with and through other people

ketu_house.station: a life touched by upheaval and by what is not spoken of: inheritance, research, crisis, and the hidden side of things
a life of faith and instruction: pilgrimage, law, teaching, and guidance given to those who asked for it
callings: the teaching of what is right

ketu_house.station: a public life: office, administration or command, with responsibility carried in the open
callings: work that carried responsibility in front of others

ketu_house.station: a life among groups: guilds, patrons, alliances, and gains that came through other people
callings: the gathering of many small gains

ketu_house.station: a life apart: retreat, foreign places, institutions of care or seclusion, and the inner life
callings: work done far from home, or apart from everyone

ketu_sign.name: Mesha
ketu_sign.temperament: forceful and quick to act, used to going first and to settling things directly

ketu_sign.name: Rishabha
ketu_sign.temperament: steady and patient, attached to comfort, to land and to what was rightfully one's own

ketu_sign.name: Mithuna
ketu_sign.temperament: quick-minded and many-sided, skilled with words, hands and the passing on of information

ketu_sign.name: Karka
ketu_sign.temperament: feeling and protective, bound closely to family, to home and to the care of others

ketu_sign.name: Simha
ketu_sign.temperament: proud and commanding, accustomed to being listened to and to answering for others

ketu_sign.name: Kanya
ketu_sign.temperament: exacting and analytical, serviceable, attentive to detail, health and method

ketu_sign.name: Tula
ketu_sign.temperament: companionable and fair-minded, made for agreement, negotiation and living alongside others

ketu_sign.name: Vrischika
ketu_sign.temperament: intense and private, enduring, well acquainted with crisis and with what survives it

ketu_sign.name: Dhanus
ketu_sign.temperament: principled and far-travelling, given to teaching and to matters of belief

ketu_sign.name: Makara
ketu_sign.temperament: disciplined and sparing, dutiful, used to carrying weight without complaint

ketu_sign.name: Kumbha
ketu_sign.temperament: unconventional and collective-minded, somewhat detached, at home among many rather than one

ketu_sign.name: Meena
ketu_sign.temperament: devotional and imaginative, self-effacing, drawn to what cannot be seen

dispositor.strong: The lord of that sign is well placed in your chart, which the tradition reads as a life whose work bore fruit: what was taken up was carried through, and it is that completed quality you are held to arrive with.
dispositor.weak: The lord of that sign is weakly placed in your chart, which the tradition reads as work left unfinished: interrupted rather than failed. That is the thread this life is held to pick up, and the section below on debts says where.

craft.craft: carried authority, and answered to no one nearby
cared for people, and moved with them
cut, built or fought, and needed a steady hand
taught, advised, or kept what is sacred
made something beautiful, or kept the peace
endured: labour, service, and the care of the old and the poor

source.note: Ketu by house and sign, read for the station and temperament carried forward, as commonly taught in modern South Indian practice; the condition of the lord of Ketu's sign is read for how that life went. From general knowledge, reviewed by AI at the product owner's direction; no textual citation has been verified. These are the tradition's inferences about orientation and pattern, never a record of events.

review.reviewer: Claude (AI review at the product owner's direction)
review.comment: Ketu house and sign tables for the life carried forward. Each entry describes a station or a temperament, never an identity, a place or a time, since a chart cannot encode those. Callings added 2026-10-05 at the product owner's direction, who asked that the reading name the kinds of life a placement is associated with rather than only its disposition. They are always several, always framed as what the tradition associates with the placement, and never asserted of the native: a chart cannot encode an occupation any more than it can encode a name. The house gives the sphere and the dispositor the craft, so the pairing is derived rather than enumerated. The Phase 9 bans on names, years, centuries and on blame are unchanged, and so is the ban on the second-person claim.
